原: …persisting with art history just doesn’t seem the right choice, Alan. / In the last three years, I have heard nothing but…
疑为: …just doesn’t seem the right choice. / Alan, in the last three years, I have heard nothing but…
理由: 说想放弃专业的是艾伦本人（第2题），句末的 Alan 是女士下一句开头的称呼，被切到上一句；翻译把“艾伦”放在第13句开头

原: Networking is key if you want to become a celebrity in the world of museums and galleries, time is a very precious commodity right now.
疑为: Networking is key if you want to become a celebrity in the world of museums and galleries. / Time is a very precious commodity right now.
理由: 前半是女士的建议，后半是男士的回答（第4题问男士缺什么），两人的话被逗号连成一句，翻译按两句译

原: When can I find time to research jobs when I have so much to do as it is.
理由: 反问句，句末应为问号，翻译按反问译

原: Questions five to eight are based on the conversation you have just heard, Question five: What are the speakers…
疑为: Questions five to eight are based on the conversation you have just heard. / Question five: What are the speakers…
理由: 念题说明和第5题连成一句，翻译分两句

原: Our findings reinforce the importance of parent conversation to promote early childhood development and curiosity,” said lead author Prachi Shah…
…accounting for 72 percent of all screen time, TVs are in 98 percent of all homes, keeping television exposure…
疑为: …accounting for 72 percent of all screen time. TVs are in 98 percent of all homes, keeping television exposure…
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，翻译按两句译

原: …which are believed to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids, our findings suggest the importance of… including while watching television. / Shah said.
疑为: “…key to cultivating curiosity in kids. Our findings suggest the importance of… including while watching television,” Shah said.
理由: 第92句是沙阿的原话（缺引号），两句被逗号连起；第93句 Shah said 是它的引述语，被句号切开

原: While your intentional aspirational goals will include the pursuit of acquiring things that will increase your sense of well-being. / They ought to also include goals to help other people…
疑为: While your intentional aspirational goals will include the pursuit of acquiring things that will increase your sense of well-being, they ought to also include…
理由: 让步从句与主句被句号切成两句，翻译按一句的意思分段译

原: These stories of people in low-income countries simply don’t make for exciting. / News coverage, but as Rosling pointed out…
疑为: These stories of people in low-income countries simply don’t make for exciting news coverage, but as Rosling pointed out…
理由: exciting news coverage 被句号从中间切断，翻译用省略号接上

原: It is obviously good news if prosperity is more shared across the globe, while inequality within countries has gone up…
疑为: It is obviously good news if prosperity is more shared across the globe. While inequality within countries has gone up…
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，翻译按两句译

原: …to the emotional and memory centers of the brain, that results in an intimate connection…
疑为: …to the emotional and memory centers of the brain. That results in an intimate connection…
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，翻译按意思连贯译出

原: The person might feel the emotion of something that happened in the past. / But won’t remember what they experienced.
疑为: The person might feel the emotion of something that happened in the past but won’t remember what they experienced.
理由: 一句被句号切成两句，翻译按一句的意思分段译

原: …they have the same drawbacks as other memories, they aren’t always accurate, and they can change over time.
疑为: …they have the same drawbacks as other memories: they aren’t always accurate, and they can change over time.
理由: 后半是对 drawbacks 的说明，应为冒号，翻译用冒号
录音第183句是 scents，sense 是同音转写错误，翻译为“气味”

原: What drawback do memories of sense share with other memories?
疑为: What drawback do memories of scents share with other memories?
理由: 同第198句，sense 应为 scents，翻译为“气味唤起的记忆”
